name: OpenWork
description: Runs agents on your local files from an open-source desktop app built on OpenCode, and shares a team's skills, plugins, and MCP connections with Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor via one hosted MCP.

skills.name: Capability Search And Run
skills.description: Finds the skills, plugins, and connections assigned to you with search_capabilities, then runs one with execute_capability.

skills.name: Shared Skill Access
skills.description: Lists your assigned skills and reads any SKILL.md directly with list_skills and get_skill from Codex, Claude Code, or another MCP client.

skills.name: Team Control Plane
skills.description: Publishes skills and plugins to an organization, team, or person, and controls which members can use each model provider, via OpenWork Den.

skills.name: Cowork Migration
skills.description: Carries over existing Claude Cowork skills, Claude-compatible plugins, and MCP servers into an OpenWork workspace on any model.
